question: where do the australian green and gold colours come from
answer: The Australian green and gold colours come from the national flower, the golden wattle (Acacia pycnantha), featured on the Coat of arms of Australia. Additionally, the colours are also associated with the Australian cricket team, which wore green and gold caps and blazers for the first time in 1899 during their tour of England.

retrieved_context.title: National colours of Australia
retrieved_context.text: The first Australian national sporting team to wear green and gold was the Australian cricket team that toured England in 1899 .
